page_title: BOL 2-1 CAG | Bologna v Cagliari 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

90+3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Cagliari are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
87' Substitution. Riccardo Orsolini will be replaced by Sam Beukema (Bologna).
86' Davide Calabria (Bologna) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Antoine Makoumbou as he is replaced by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
84' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Remo Freuler (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
81' Bologna hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
80' Florinel Coman (Cagliari) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
78' Cagliari are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
77' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
77' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Zufferli had an easy-decision to make.
76' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Nadir Zortea is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
76' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
73' Cagliari are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
71' The players claim that Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
67' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is being substituted because of an injury. Davide Nicola sends Razvan Marin on the pitch.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Martin Erlic departs the field of play to be replaced by Nicolo Casale (Bologna).
67' Zito Luvumbo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Florinel Coman (Cagliari).
62' Referee Luca Zufferli sees the trip by Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
62' A spell of possession for Cagliari in an attempt to control the game.

56' 2 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
55' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Elia Caprile (Cagliari).
55' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
55' The ball is out of play and Bologna manage to earn a corner.
54' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
54' Bologna are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
50' Great teamplay by Bologna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
48' 1 - 1 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Elia Caprile into the bottom left corner.
48' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
47' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) makes a slide tackle, but referee Luca Zufferli blows for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Bologna!
46' Half-time substitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) will not participate anymore and Lewis Ferguson is coming on.
46' Vincenzo Italiano makes a half-time substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi comes on in place of Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
46' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jens Odgaard (Bologna) replacing Tommaso Pobega.
46' Davide Nicola has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Mattia Felici comes on the pitch for Adam Obert (Cagliari).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Martin Erlic (Bologna) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The referee blows his whistle as Michel Adopo (Cagliari) was too aggressive in his challenge.

44' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Luca Zufferli blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

43' Santiago Castro (Bologna) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Elia Caprile was alert and the score remained the same.
42' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
42' Some patient build-up play from Bologna as they look to unlock the defence.
41' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.

40' What a chance that is! Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
39' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
38' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
37' Bologna hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
35' Santiago Castro (Bologna) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
34' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is penalised for a foul. Luca Zufferli had a clear view and blows his whistle.
33' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
32' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar.
30' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends a long ball in, but Elia Caprile comfortably gathers the ball.
29' What was Adam Obert (Cagliari) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
27' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
25' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
24' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.

22' 0 - 1 Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) scores a goal! A perfectly produced cross puts him one-on-one with the goalkeeper and he plants a brilliant header down in the middle of the net, leaving the goalkeeper beaten!
21' Remo Freuler (Bologna) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
18' Santiago Castro (Bologna) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Luca Zufferli who sees an offensive foul.
18' Bologna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

16' What a chance that is! Santiago Castro (Bologna) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post.
15' Santiago Castro (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' The ball possession is 66:34.
12' Neat passing move from Bologna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
10' The game is interrupted now, Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
10' Luca Zufferli couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) and blew his whistle.
9' Martin Erlic (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Davide Calabria (Bologna), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bologna.
1' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli is introduced as the referee for today's match.
